title: sing-attune pitch frame protocol v1
description: A pitch observation emitted by /ws/pitch at approximately 20 Hz while playback is active. Time is measured from the playback anchor, never from a wall clock.

t.description: Milliseconds since playback start, adjusted for pause, resume, seek, and tempo.

midi.description: Fractional MIDI note number; the fractional part carries cent detail.

conf.description: Pitch detector confidence. Frames below the backend threshold are not emitted.
